scope: Account section only. Scores assess visible presentation; interactions, focus behavior and measured contrast were not tested.

findings.element: Remaining heading and collapsed account summaries
findings.fix: Identify the main percentage as weekly quota remaining and expose compact, resource-specific low-quota lines beneath accounts 1 and 2.
findings.evidence: The generic heading and three identical 82.8% summaries provide no visible resource-warning distinction.

findings.fix: Give the action a restrained dark button surface and border so it separates from the adjacent account counts.

findings.observation: Bold weekly percentages retain priority. Indented warning labels and right-aligned amber values add useful meaning in one extra line. Account 3 remains visually quiet.

findings.fix: Name the weekly quota explicitly and show each affected resource's low status beneath its account name.
findings.evidence: The three equally prominent 82.8% values make the account summaries appear equivalent.

findings.fix: Add a compact dark button boundary to distinguish the action from header metadata.

findings.observation: The resource labels fit on one line, warning values share the main percentages' right edges, and the columns retain clear separation at this width.

findings.element: Header counts and Expand All button
findings.fix: Keep '3 loaded · 3 eligible' together beneath Accounts and reserve enough button width for a single-line Expand All label.
findings.evidence: The count breaks before 'eligible' and the action breaks between 'Expand' and 'All', creating competing two-line blocks.

findings.fix: Clarify that the bold values represent weekly quota and add concise resource-specific warnings below affected account names.
Reduce the vertical gap between the title/count/button group and the quota caption, keeping the caption immediately above the percentage column.
findings.evidence: The header occupies about 80 pixels of a 243-pixel crop. Its separate caption band takes substantial space before the first account.
findings.comparison: The single-line button and coherent count line improve wrapping, but the header is about 20 pixels taller than before.

findings.element: Long account name, chevron and 82.8% value
findings.fix: Align the chevron and weekly percentage with the first line of the account name while allowing the full name to wrap.
findings.evidence: The percentage and chevron sit near the middle of the three-line name, unlike the first-line alignment of a simple account row.

findings.fix: Keep the button label on one line and place the complete count phrase beneath Accounts.

findings.element: Quota heading and account status summaries
findings.fix: Replace the generic Remaining heading with the weekly metric name and expose resource-specific low warnings while retaining Weekly quota unavailable.
Tighten the space above and below Weekly quota remaining so the long account name starts sooner without truncating it or its warning.
findings.evidence: The header consumes about 80 pixels before a necessarily multiline account row.
findings.comparison: The header grows by about 20 pixels, although improved wrapping and first-line numeric alignment raise the overall layout score.

findings.observation: Weekly quota unavailable remains distinct from 5-Hour Limit · Low and its 14% value. The screenshot preserves both meanings without conflating their numbers.

findings.fix: Specify weekly quota remaining and show compact low-resource warnings for accounts 1 and 2, preserving account 3's Unavailable message.
Align the chevron and dash with the account-name row; keep Unavailable on the secondary line.
findings.evidence: The chevron sits beside the status line and the dash sits below the neighboring percentages' baseline.

findings.fix: Give the action a compact, visible dark button boundary.

findings.observation: Names and primary values now align across columns. Low-resource lines and Unavailable occupy a consistent secondary tier.

findings.element: Generic Remaining heading and stale message
findings.fix: Name the weekly metric, retain one Stale label beside its value, and put Last observed on a dedicated secondary line without repeating Stale in that sentence.

findings.element: Account 3 chevron, timestamp and primary value
findings.fix: Align the chevron, account name and percentage on the first row, then let the timestamp use the full secondary row.
findings.evidence: The chevron follows the multiline status block, the timestamp wraps, and the percentage sits below the other accounts' values.

findings.fix: Separate the action from the counts with a restrained dark button surface.

findings.element: Account 3 name and chevron beside the 82.8% / Stale stack
findings.fix: Top-align the name and chevron with the 82.8% row and the other account names. Keep Stale directly beneath the value and Last observed on its own line.
findings.regression: Hierarchy drops from 8 to 7: account 3's name now sits visibly lower than accounts 1 and 2, centered beside the two-line value/status stack. Previously the account names shared a baseline.
findings.evidence: The percentage alignment improves, but its status stack now displaces the account identity.

findings.observation: The single-line Last observed timestamp and single Stale label remove repetition while preserving the warning.

findings.element: Last observed / Next reset metadata blocks
findings.fix: Start the metadata blocks on a shared horizontal boundary below the tallest quota list and add a subtle divider.
findings.evidence: Account 1's extra quota row pushes its metadata below the corresponding blocks in accounts 2 and 3.

findings.fix: Add a short Low label beside each affected resource while retaining the amber values.
findings.evidence: The warning distinction is communicated through amber numbers without an explicit severity word.

findings.fix: Give the action the same restrained button boundary used for the compact header action.
Increase the smallest reset captions slightly toward the neighboring secondary-text size, preserving their subordinate colour and keeping each caption on one line.
findings.evidence: Reset dates are visibly smaller than the quota labels and lower metadata values.

findings.fix: Increase the reset captions slightly toward the size of Last observed and Next reset labels; retain subdued colour and compact spacing.
findings.evidence: The smallest operational timestamps remain noticeably harder to read than the rest of the account details.

findings.observation: The shared divider and aligned metadata rows improve cross-account scanning. The space beneath shorter quota lists supports that alignment; keep it.

summary: The AFTER screenshots improve warning visibility, metric naming and cross-account alignment. Prioritize fixing the stale account's lowered name baseline, tightening narrow headers, and slightly enlarging expanded reset captions. Preserve the dark palette, amber warning text and explicit resource names.
